title: 第15章 青锋夜螳我需要奶妈第16章 幻影分身三息斩赤犬
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 回到戒刀狒狒族群领地。
经过掘地三尺，夜玄成功寻到想要之物。
拇指大小的半透明瓷瓶内，好似封存一泓流动的绛色星河，暗红色粘稠液体随着瓷瓶晃动而流转，折射出星星点点光泽。
这，就是由魔药师制作而成的三阶魔药血菩提。
三阶魔药血菩提。
普通血脉品质妖宠吞服，可蜕变成精英级别。
放眼整个石城夜家。
能炼出三品魔药的魔药师，也只有一个人。
地位几乎与夜玄便宜老爹平起平坐。
可见魔药师是有多么吃香。
夜玄自三尺深坑洞爬出，丢出手中的药瓶。
“夜狩，喝下去。”
夜狩会意，张嘴叼住瓷瓶仰头一口咬碎！
星光液体入口，夜狩身躯猛然一颤，下一刻，甲壳下每一寸骨骼，都在发出令人牙酸咯吱声，血肉更是如同沸腾般翻涌。
渐渐的，它的躯体开始以肉眼可见速度发生蜕变，朝着更高层次的生命形态进化。
数分钟后，夜狩蜕变结束，正式踏入精英级层次。
精英级，青锋夜螳。
青黑色厚重甲壳，标志性粗硕左臂，青锋夜螳专属标志。
与平常的青锋夜螳不同的是，夜狩胸前黑甲，附着一枚栩栩如生的金色蜂首纹路图案。
“不错。”
夜玄点头，围绕一人高的夜狩转悠，时不时伸手敲打对方那势大力沉的斩首刀左臂。
观摩会，他停住脚步，通过兽契，指向一棵半米粗细古树发出命令，“夜狩，试试十字斩击。”
指令刚刚下达，夜狩动了。
恍若只奔腾恶虎，弹射起步，投射向古树！
天赋掠影给予夜狩超绝速度。
夜玄眼前一晃，刹那间，便见暗红色刀芒释放而出，交织成丈许宽的十字能量斩击。
啪的下，古树干脆利落拦腰斩断。
其断口处光滑如镜。
隐约可见暗红能量如活物般侵蚀木质纹理。
精英级妖兽与普通妖兽最大的区别，就是可以施展属性攻击，夜狩为暗属性妖兽，踏入精英，攻击自然也就附带暗属性。
夜玄很满意夜狩的变化。
数里外小树林，夕阳如血，透过枝丫挥洒地面，染上一抹凄凉橘红色，此时，囚徒数量已经汇聚四十余名。
“奇怪。”
“都过去如此长的时间，夜少怎么还未回来？”
树下，鹿二发忍不住自言自语，掏出枚青色果实大口啃咬。

Return to the territory of the Ringed Knife Baboon Clan.
After digging three feet into the ground, Ye Xuan successfully found what he wanted.
The thumb-sized translucent porcelain bottle seems to contain a flowing crimson galaxy. The dark red viscous liquid flows as the porcelain bottle shakes, reflecting the stars' luster.
This is the third-level magic medicine Blood Bodhi made by a magician.
The third-level magic medicine Blood Bodhi.
If a demon pet of ordinary bloodline quality is swallowed, it can transform into an elite level.
Look at the entire Shicheng Ye family.
There is only one potion master who can make third-grade potions.
His status is almost equal to that of Ye Xuan's cheap father.
This shows how popular potion masters are.
Ye Xuan crawled out of the three-foot-deep hole and threw out the medicine bottle in his hand.
"Ye Shou, drink it."
"Hiss!"
Ye Shou understood, opened his mouth, held the porcelain bottle, raised his head and bit it into pieces!
"Crack!"
When the starlight liquid entered the entrance, Ye Shou's body trembled suddenly. The next moment, every inch of the bones under the carapace made a heart-breaking creaking sound, and the flesh and blood surged like boiling.
Gradually, its body began to transform at a speed visible to the naked eye, evolving towards a higher level of life form.
A few minutes later, Ye Shou's transformation ended and he officially entered the elite level.
Elite level, Qingfeng Ye Mantis.
The thick green and black carapace, the iconic thick left arm, the exclusive logo of Qingfeng Night Mantis.
Different from the ordinary Qingfeng Ye Mantis, Ye Shou has a lifelike golden bee head pattern attached to its black armor on its chest.
"Not bad."
Ye Xuan nodded and walked around Ye Shou, who was as tall as one person. From time to time, he stretched out his hand to hit the left arm of the opponent's powerful and heavy decapitation knife.
During the observation meeting, he stopped and pointed at an ancient tree half a meter thick through the animal contract and issued an order, "Night hunting, try the cross slash."
"Hiss!"
Just as the order was given, Ye Shou moved.
Like a galloping tiger, it ejects and projects towards the ancient tree!
The talent Glimpse gives Night Hunter super speed.
Ye Xuan's eyes flashed, and in an instant, he saw the dark red sword light being released, intertwining into a cross energy slash that was several feet wide.
With a snap, the ancient tree was cut in half.
Its fracture is as smooth as a mirror.
You can vaguely see the dark red energy eroding the wood texture like a living thing.
The biggest difference between elite monsters and ordinary monsters is that they can perform attribute attacks. Ye Shou is a dark attribute monster. If you become an elite, your attacks will naturally have dark attributes.
Ye Xuan is very satisfied with Ye Shou's changes.
…
In the woods a few miles away, the sunset was like blood, shining through the branches on the ground, dyeing it with a touch of desolate orange. At this time, there were more than forty prisoners gathered.
"Strange."
"It's been such a long time, why hasn't Young Master Ye come back yet?"
Under the tree, Lu Erfa couldn't help but talk to himself, took out a green fruit and took a big bite.
